intro.heading: 🏦 Introduction to PM Mudra Loan
intro.content: The PM Mudra Loan is a government-backed scheme that provides financial assistance to small businesses and entrepreneurs in India. The scheme was launched in 2015 and has been a huge success, with millions of beneficiaries across the country. In this article, we will guide you on how to apply for PM Mudra Loan online in 2026. So, let's get started! 📈

sections.heading: 📊 Eligibility Criteria for PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: To be eligible for a PM Mudra Loan, you must meet the following criteria: ✅ You must be an Indian citizen. ✅ You must be above 18 years of age. ✅ You must have a business plan or a proposal for a new business. ✅ Your business must be in the manufacturing, trading, or service sector. The loan amount varies from ₹50,000 to ₹10 lakhs, depending on the type of business and the loan scheme you apply for.

sections.heading: 📁 Required Documents for PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan, you will need to submit the following documents: ✅ Identity proof (Aadhaar card, PAN card, etc.). ✅ Address proof (passport, driving license, etc.). ✅ Business plan or proposal. ✅ Proof of business existence (registration certificate, etc.). ✅ Bank statement and income tax returns. Make sure you have all the required documents before applying for the loan.

sections.heading: 📈 Step-by-Step Guide to Apply for PM Mudra Loan Online
sections.content: Here's a step-by-step guide to apply for PM Mudra Loan online: ✅ Visit the official website of the lender or the PM Mudra Loan portal. ✅ Fill out the online application form with your personal and business details. ✅ Upload the required documents. ✅ Submit the application form and wait for the lender to review your application. ✅ Once your application is approved, you will receive the loan amount in your bank account. The entire process is quick and easy, and you can get the loan amount in just a few days.

faqs.q: What is the interest rate for PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The interest rate for PM Mudra Loan varies from 8.5% to 12.5% per annum, depending on the lender and the loan scheme.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get a PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The processing time for PM Mudra Loan is usually 7-10 working days, but it may vary depending on the lender and the complexity of the application.
